source: Nexora deterministic GA demonstration dataset v2.0

story.yesterday: Cloud and SaaS costs were reviewed independently, obscuring the total cost and dependency impact of the digital-commerce estate.
story.today: Certified evidence connects $214M of technology investment to 340 business services across 42 countries.
story.risk: Checkout services depend on two end-of-support technologies and one concentrated payment vendor; delay increases peak-season continuity risk.
story.recommendation: Approve the phased checkout modernization and consolidate 38 overlapping SaaS subscriptions, subject to the documented service migration controls.
story.business_outcome: The governed plan protects checkout continuity and identifies $12.4M of annual opportunity without presenting it as realized value.
story.action: CIO and CFO review investment option NXR-INV-204; the Risk Committee confirms migration controls before approval.

decisions.title: Consolidate overlapping collaboration and analytics SaaS
